description: Source code for the credential cache daemon in Git, implementing credential caching over UNIX sockets with functions for credential management, socket setup, and server loop.

methods.name: cache_credential
methods.description: Stores a credential in the cache with a specified timeout.

methods.name: lookup_credential
methods.description: Finds a credential in the cache matching given criteria.

methods.name: remove_credential
methods.description: Removes or invalidates a credential from the cache.

methods.name: check_expirations
methods.description: Checks and removes expired credentials, returns time until next expiration.

methods.name: read_request
methods.description: Reads a credential request from a client.

methods.name: serve_one_client
methods.description: Handles a single client request for credential operations.

methods.name: serve_cache_loop
methods.description: Main loop for accepting and serving client connections.

methods.name: serve_cache
methods.description: Sets up UNIX socket and runs the server loop.

methods.name: init_socket_directory
methods.description: Prepares the socket directory with correct permissions.

methods.name: cmd_credential_cache_daemon
methods.description: Main entry point for the credential cache daemon command.
